name: Get WhatsApp client info
description: Call this when you need the WhatsApp-specific account context before working with WhatsApp templates or campaigns: the account id, the WhatsApp auth token used by the WhatsApp API host, whether WhatsApp is disabled for the account, the template-level privileges (create/edit, send, share), the remaining free message allowance, and the account time zone and time format. Use it to decide up front whether a WhatsApp template action is permitted at all, rather than attempting the action and handling a rejection. For general account or plan details not specific to WhatsApp, use the account/organization details action instead; for the app-wide feature toggle list, use the feature toggles action instead — the feature_toggle map here only carries WhatsApp-related flags.
preconditions: An authenticated Brevo web app session is required.
The WhatsApp API host (whatsapp-api.brevo.com) must be reachable; this endpoint is not part of the public Brevo API.

id.description: Identifier of the WhatsApp client record for the current user.

account_id.description: Brevo account identifier the WhatsApp client belongs to.

name.description: Display name of the account owner.

auth_token.description: Token the web app uses for subsequent WhatsApp API calls. Treat as a secret.

activated_applications.description: Brevo applications activated for this account, as observed: automation, email-campaigns, transactional-emails, crm, whatsapp, phone, meetings, sms-campaigns.

feature_toggle.description: WhatsApp-related feature flags keyed by flag name with boolean values. Observed keys: dedup-customization-enabled, whatsapp-editor-ai.

whatsapp-editor-ai.description: Whether AI assistance in the WhatsApp editor is enabled.

free_messages.description: Remaining free WhatsApp message allowance, returned as a string.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the account, e.g. America/Sao_Paulo.

time_format.description: Clock format preference for the account, e.g. "24".

email_account_invalidated.description: Whether the account email has been invalidated.

privileges.description: What the current user may do with WhatsApp templates.

template_crud.description: Whether the user may create, edit and delete WhatsApp templates.

template_send.description: Whether the user may send using WhatsApp templates.

template_share.description: Whether the user may share WhatsApp templates.

whatsapp_disabled.description: Whether WhatsApp is disabled for this account.

is_enterprise.description: Whether the account is an enterprise account.

is_corporate_subaccount.description: Whether the account is a subaccount of a corporate parent.

excluded_conversion_user.description: Whether the user is excluded from conversion tracking.

newSignupFlow.description: Whether the account went through the newer signup flow.

phoneNumber.description: WhatsApp sender phone number on the account; empty when none is configured.
